text:
sam.sales: Quick handoff — just closed with Meridian Labs. They signed for Dedicated capacity + Private deployment (VPC). Need CS to own onboarding and surface renewal risk (12-mo term).
maria.cs: Thanks Sam. Can you drop the integration & SSO details? Any blockers from legal/infosec?
sam.sales: Key asks: SAML IdP w/ SCIM provisioning, private model hosting, and higher token throughput initially. Legal asked for DPA signed (done). Infosec wants KMS integration + audit logs. Renewal risk: procurement pushed discount requests, noted.
devon.enablement: Noted. I'll own initial enablement runbook and onboarding playbook. Planning a 4-week runway: week0 provisioning, week1 SSO + infra smoke, week2 prompts & evals, week3 performance tuning.
alex.support: I'll pair for infra tickets — assuming we need a dedicated VPC peering + manifest for model pull? Please create support ticket with infra details and expected timelines.
sam.sales: Created ticket #SF-8123 and attached contract excerpt + network CID ranges. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SF-8123
priya.successops: I'll track account health metrics and renewal cadence. Propose check-ins: weekly for first month, then biweekly. Also capture feedback after enablement session.
maria.cs: Action list coming out of this thread: 1) devon: build onboarding runbook (due in 48h) 2) alex: scope SF-8123 infra items and estimate (48h) 3) priya: draft renewal risk note + customer health dashboard (72h) 4) sam: share SAML metadata and SCIM test user (ASAP)
devon.enablement: Starting runbook now — initial checklist snippet below for reference:
```
- Provision VPC & peering
- Request KMS key (customer-managed)
- Deploy model variant: redwood-v1-dedicated
- Configure SAML (IdP metadata) + SCIM test user
- Run perf smoke: 10k tokens across 50 sessions
```
alex.support: I pulled SF-8123 and added preliminary infra items. Need SAML metadata and KMS ARN. Will add estimated ETA to the ticket.
sam.sales: Pasted SAML metadata into the ticket and added contact (security@meridian.io).
priya.successops: I'll stub a dashboard tile for token usage, error rate, and eval quality score. Also adding a renewal-risk tag: "discount-requested" + "procurement-delay".
maria.cs: One more: capture enablement feedback with this quick survey link after session — https://forms.redwood.com/enablement-quick. Please tag responses in SF-8123.
sam.sales: :thumbsup: thanks team. Passing to CS.
deploy-bot: Deployment notification — onboarding-runbook-template v3 applied to account workspace.
maria.cs: Closing loop — will post a kickoff calendar invite for next Tue and update this thread with owners' progress. If anything urgent ping me directly. :calendar:
